usage: The word '隊友' is used to refer to a teammate or a member of the same team in sports or group activities.
'隊友' functions as a noun and usually appears as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can use '隊友' to talk about someone you cooperate or compete with in team sports.
It can be used to express relationships, roles, or support among members within a team.
'隊友' can be plural or singular depending on the context without changing the form.
